blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Budget and Management (DBM) on Monday cautioned the public against circulating false information about a supposed cash incentive for qualified government employees in 2026. In a statement, the DBM clarified that the document spreading online—specifically regarding a 2026 Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) citing Administrative Order (AO) No. 40—is not an official issuance by the department.
